EVENT Page.PreRender
    CALL Me.RefreshEntries()
END EVENT

EVENT Submit
    IF Me.SaveEntry() THEN
        CALL Me.Clear()
        FOR EACH sibling IN Me.related("parent").related("children", "blocks")
            IF sibling.id = "guestbook-status" THEN
                sibling.Set("content", {"type":"markdown", "value":"Thank you for signing the guestbook."})
            END IF
        NEXT sibling
    ELSE
        FOR EACH other IN Me.related("parent").related("children", "blocks")
            IF other.id = "guestbook-status" THEN
                other.Set("content", {"type":"markdown", "value":"Your entry could not be saved. Your message is still in the form."})
            END IF
        NEXT other
    END IF
END EVENT

FUNCTION FindNode(parent AS Wydgit, slotName AS String, sId AS String) AS Wydgit
    FOR EACH node IN parent.related("children", slotName)
        IF node.id = sId THEN
            RETURN node
        END IF
    NEXT node
    RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION

EVENT Submit
    Dim targetRecId As String
    targetRecId = REQUEST.Form.Get("recordId")

    Dim postedOffset As String
    postedOffset = REQUEST.Form.Get("pageOffset")

    If targetRecId <> "" Then
        Dim getRes As Object
        getRes = SERVICES.Call("wydstore", "get", {
            "store": "tasks",
            "collection": "tasks",
            "id": targetRecId
        })

        If getRes.ok Then
            Dim recSnapshot As Object
            recSnapshot = getRes.value

            Dim currentVersion As Number
            currentVersion = recSnapshot.version

            Dim delRes As Object
            delRes = SERVICES.Call("wydstore", "delete", {
                "store": "tasks",
                "collection": "tasks",
                "id": targetRecId,
                "version": currentVersion
            })

            If delRes.ok Then
                Dim cardObj As Wydgit
                SET cardObj = Me.related("parent")

                If cardObj IS NOT NULL Then
                    Dim colObj As Wydgit
                    SET colObj = cardObj.related("parent")

                    If colObj IS NOT NULL Then
                        Dim listSec As Wydgit
                        SET listSec = colObj.related("parent")

                        If listSec IS NOT NULL Then
                            Dim rootSec As Wydgit
                            SET rootSec = listSec.related("parent")

                            If rootSec IS NOT NULL AND postedOffset <> "" Then
                                Dim pageForm As Wydgit
                                SET pageForm = FindNode(rootSec, "blocks", "taskboard-page-form")
                                If pageForm IS NOT NULL THEN
                                    Dim offsetField AS Wydgit
                                    SET offsetField = FindNode(pageForm, "blocks", "taskboard-page-offset")
                                    IF offsetField IS NOT NULL THEN
                                        offsetField.value = postedOffset
                                    END IF
                                END IF
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                    cardObj.Remove()
                END IF
            End If
        End If
    End If
END EVENT

FUNCTION FindNode(parent AS Wydgit, slotName AS String, sId AS String) AS Wydgit
    FOR EACH node IN parent.related("children", slotName)
        IF node.id = sId THEN
            RETURN node
        END IF
    NEXT node
    RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION

EVENT Submit
    Dim targetRecId As String
    targetRecId = REQUEST.Form.Get("recordId")

    Dim newStatus As String
    newStatus = REQUEST.Form.Get("targetStatus")

    Dim postedOffset As String
    postedOffset = REQUEST.Form.Get("pageOffset")

    If newStatus = "todo" OR newStatus = "doing" OR newStatus = "done" Then
        If targetRecId <> "" Then
            Dim getRes As Object
            getRes = SERVICES.Call("wydstore", "get", {
                "store": "tasks",
                "collection": "tasks",
                "id": targetRecId
            })

            If getRes.ok Then
                Dim recSnapshot As Object
                recSnapshot = getRes.value

                Dim titleStr As String
                Dim currentData As Object
                currentData = recSnapshot.data
                titleStr = currentData.title

                Dim currentStatus As String
                currentStatus = currentData.status

                Dim validTransition As Boolean
                validTransition = False

                If currentStatus = "todo" AND newStatus = "doing" Then
                    validTransition = True
                ElseIf currentStatus = "doing" AND newStatus = "done" Then
                    validTransition = True
                ElseIf currentStatus = "done" AND newStatus = "todo" Then
                    validTransition = True
                End If

                If validTransition Then
                    Dim currentVersion As Number
                    currentVersion = recSnapshot.version

                    Dim updateRes As Object
                    updateRes = SERVICES.Call("wydstore", "update", {
                        "store": "tasks",
                        "collection": "tasks",
                        "id": targetRecId,
                        "version": currentVersion,
                        "data": {
                            "title": titleStr,
                            "status": newStatus
                        }
                    })

                    If updateRes.ok Then
                        Dim moveForm As Wydgit
                        SET moveForm = Me

                        Dim cardObj As Wydgit
                        SET cardObj = moveForm.related("parent")

                        If cardObj IS NOT NULL Then
                            Dim oldColObj As Wydgit
                            SET oldColObj = cardObj.related("parent")

                            If oldColObj IS NOT NULL Then
                                Dim listSec As Wydgit
                                SET listSec = oldColObj.related("parent")

                                If listSec IS NOT NULL Then
                                    Dim rootSec As Wydgit
                                    SET rootSec = listSec.related("parent")

                                    If rootSec IS NOT NULL AND postedOffset <> "" Then
                                        Dim pageForm As Wydgit
                                        SET pageForm = FindNode(rootSec, "blocks", "taskboard-page-form")
                                        If pageForm IS NOT NULL Then
                                            Dim offsetField AS Wydgit
                                            SET offsetField = FindNode(pageForm, "blocks", "taskboard-page-offset")
                                            IF offsetField IS NOT NULL THEN
                                                offsetField.value = postedOffset
                                            END IF
                                        End If
                                    End If

                                    Dim targetColId As String
                                    Dim nextStatusArg As String
                                    Dim nextBtnLabel As String

                                    If newStatus = "doing" Then
                                        targetColId = "col-doing"
                                        nextStatusArg = "done"
                                        nextBtnLabel = "Complete ->"
                                    ElseIf newStatus = "done" Then
                                        targetColId = "col-done"
                                        nextStatusArg = "todo"
                                        nextBtnLabel = "<- Reopen"
                                    Else
                                        targetColId = "col-todo"
                                        nextStatusArg = "doing"
                                        nextBtnLabel = "Start ->"
                                    End If

                                    Dim newColObj As Wydgit
                                    SET newColObj = FindNode(listSec, "blocks", targetColId)

                                    If newColObj IS NOT NULL Then
                                        cardObj.Move(newColObj, "blocks", 1)
                                        cardObj.status = newStatus
                                        moveForm.label = titleStr & " | " & nextBtnLabel

                                        Dim statusHidden As Wydgit
                                        SET statusHidden = FindNode(moveForm, "blocks", "task-card-move-" & targetRecId & "-status")
                                        If statusHidden IS NOT NULL THEN
                                            statusHidden.value = nextStatusArg
                                        END IF
                                    End If
                                End If
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
    End If
END EVENT

FUNCTION FindNode(parent AS Wydgit, slotName AS String, sId AS String) AS Wydgit
    FOR EACH node IN parent.related("children", slotName)
        IF node.id = sId THEN
            RETURN node
        END IF
    NEXT node
    RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION

EVENT Submit
    Dim postedOffset As String
    postedOffset = REQUEST.Form.Get("offset")

    If postedOffset <> "" Then
        Dim pagingForm As Wydgit
        SET pagingForm = Me

        Dim rootSec As Wydgit
        SET rootSec = pagingForm.related("parent")

        If rootSec IS NOT NULL Then
            Dim pageForm As Wydgit
            SET pageForm = FindNode(rootSec, "blocks", "taskboard-page-form")
            If pageForm IS NOT NULL Then
                Dim pageOffsetField As Wydgit
                SET pageOffsetField = FindNode(pageForm, "blocks", "taskboard-page-offset")
                If pageOffsetField IS NOT NULL Then
                    pageOffsetField.value = postedOffset
                End If
            End If

            Dim prevForm As Wydgit
            SET prevForm = FindNode(rootSec, "blocks", "taskboard-prev-form")
            If prevForm IS NOT NULL Then
                Dim prevOffsetField As Wydgit
                SET prevOffsetField = FindNode(prevForm, "blocks", "taskboard-prev-offset")
                If prevOffsetField IS NOT NULL Then
                    prevOffsetField.value = postedOffset
                End If
            End If
        End If
    End If
END EVENT

FUNCTION FindNode(parent AS Wydgit, slotName AS String, sId AS String) AS Wydgit
    FOR EACH node IN parent.related("children", slotName)
        IF node.id = sId THEN
            RETURN node
        END IF
    NEXT node
    RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION

EVENT Page.Resolve
    Dim reqTarget As String
    reqTarget = REQUEST.Route.target

    Dim reqRecId As String
    reqRecId = REQUEST.Form.Get("recordId")

    Dim reqOffset As String
    reqOffset = REQUEST.Form.Get("pageOffset")

    If reqRecId <> "" Then
        Dim expectedTarget As String
        expectedTarget = "task-card-delete-" & reqRecId

        If reqTarget = expectedTarget Then
            Dim getRes As Object
            getRes = SERVICES.Call("wydstore", "get", {
                "store": "tasks",
                "collection": "tasks",
                "id": reqRecId
            })

            If getRes.ok Then
                Dim recSnapshot As Object
                recSnapshot = getRes.value

                Dim taskData As Object
                taskData = recSnapshot.data

                Dim titleStr As String
                titleStr = taskData.title

                Dim currentStatus As String
                currentStatus = taskData.status

                Dim colId As String
                If currentStatus = "doing" Then
                    colId = "col-doing"
                ElseIf currentStatus = "done" Then
                    colId = "col-done"
                Else
                    colId = "col-todo"
                End If

                Dim cardId As String
                cardId = "task-card-" & reqRecId

                Dim card As Wydgit
                SET card = NEW "divdev/task-card"(cardId)
                card.taskTitle = "**" & titleStr & "**"
                card.status = currentStatus
                card.recordId = reqRecId

                If reqOffset = "" Then
                    reqOffset = "0"
                End If

                ' Move Form
                Dim moveForm As Wydgit
                SET moveForm = NEW "divdev/task-move-form"("task-card-move-" & reqRecId)
                moveForm.label = titleStr

                Dim hiddenRecMove As Wydgit
                SET hiddenRecMove = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"("task-card-move-" & reqRecId & "-recid")
                hiddenRecMove.name = "recordId"
                hiddenRecMove.value = reqRecId
                moveForm.Insert("blocks", 0, hiddenRecMove)

                Dim hiddenOffsetMove As Wydgit
                SET hiddenOffsetMove = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"("task-card-move-" & reqRecId & "-offset")
                hiddenOffsetMove.name = "pageOffset"
                hiddenOffsetMove.value = reqOffset
                moveForm.Insert("blocks", 1, hiddenOffsetMove)

                card.Insert("blocks", 0, moveForm)

                ' Delete Form Receiver (Target)
                Dim reconstructedForm As Wydgit
                SET reconstructedForm = NEW "divdev/task-delete-form"(expectedTarget)
                reconstructedForm.label = "Delete"

                Dim hiddenRecDel As Wydgit
                SET hiddenRecDel = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"(expectedTarget & "-recid")
                hiddenRecDel.name = "recordId"
                hiddenRecDel.value = reqRecId
                reconstructedForm.Insert("blocks", 0, hiddenRecDel)

                Dim hiddenOffsetDel As Wydgit
                SET hiddenOffsetDel = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"(expectedTarget & "-offset")
                hiddenOffsetDel.name = "pageOffset"
                hiddenOffsetDel.value = reqOffset
                reconstructedForm.Insert("blocks", 1, hiddenOffsetDel)

                card.Insert("blocks", 1, reconstructedForm)

                Dim listSec As Wydgit
                SET listSec = FindNode(Me, "blocks", "taskboard-list-section")

                If listSec IS NOT NULL Then
                    Dim targetCol As Wydgit
                    SET targetCol = FindNode(listSec, "blocks", colId)

                    If targetCol IS NOT NULL Then
                        targetCol.Insert("blocks", 1, card)
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
    End If
END EVENT

FUNCTION FindNode(parent AS Wydgit, slotName AS String, sId AS String) AS Wydgit
    FOR EACH node IN parent.related("children", slotName)
        IF node.id = sId THEN
            RETURN node
        END IF
    NEXT node
    RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION

EVENT Page.Resolve
    Dim reqTarget As String
    reqTarget = REQUEST.Route.target

    Dim reqRecId As String
    reqRecId = REQUEST.Form.Get("recordId")

    Dim reqOffset As String
    reqOffset = REQUEST.Form.Get("pageOffset")

    If reqRecId <> "" Then
        Dim expectedTarget As String
        expectedTarget = "task-card-move-" & reqRecId

        If reqTarget = expectedTarget Then
            Dim getRes As Object
            getRes = SERVICES.Call("wydstore", "get", {
                "store": "tasks",
                "collection": "tasks",
                "id": reqRecId
            })

            If getRes.ok Then
                Dim recSnapshot As Object
                recSnapshot = getRes.value

                Dim taskData As Object
                taskData = recSnapshot.data

                Dim titleStr As String
                titleStr = taskData.title

                Dim currentStatus As String
                currentStatus = taskData.status

                Dim nextStatus As String
                Dim btnLabel As String
                Dim colId As String

                If currentStatus = "doing" Then
                    nextStatus = "done"
                    btnLabel = "Complete ->"
                    colId = "col-doing"
                ElseIf currentStatus = "done" Then
                    nextStatus = "todo"
                    btnLabel = "<- Reopen"
                    colId = "col-done"
                Else
                    nextStatus = "doing"
                    btnLabel = "Start ->"
                    colId = "col-todo"
                End If

                Dim cardId As String
                cardId = "task-card-" & reqRecId

                Dim card As Wydgit
                SET card = NEW "divdev/task-card"(cardId)

                card.status = currentStatus
                card.recordId = reqRecId

                If reqOffset = "" Then
                    reqOffset = "0"

                ' 1. Move Form Receiver (Target)
                Dim reconstructedForm As Wydgit
                SET reconstructedForm = NEW "divdev/task-move-form"(expectedTarget)
                reconstructedForm.label = titleStr & " | " & btnLabel

                Dim hiddenRec As Wydgit
                SET hiddenRec = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"(expectedTarget & "-recid")
                hiddenRec.name = "recordId"
                hiddenRec.value = reqRecId
                reconstructedForm.Insert("blocks", 0, hiddenRec)

                Dim hiddenStatus As Wydgit
                SET hiddenStatus = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"(expectedTarget & "-status")
                hiddenStatus.name = "targetStatus"
                hiddenStatus.value = nextStatus
                reconstructedForm.Insert("blocks", 1, hiddenStatus)

                Dim hiddenOffset As Wydgit
                SET hiddenOffset = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"(expectedTarget & "-offset")
                hiddenOffset.name = "pageOffset"
                hiddenOffset.value = reqOffset
                reconstructedForm.Insert("blocks", 2, hiddenOffset)

                card.Insert("blocks", 0, reconstructedForm)

                ' 2. Delete Form
                Dim delForm As Wydgit
                SET delForm = NEW "divdev/task-delete-form"("task-card-delete-" & reqRecId)
                delForm.label = "Delete"

                Dim hiddenDelRec As Wydgit
                SET hiddenDelRec = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"("task-card-delete-" & reqRecId & "-recid")
                hiddenDelRec.name = "recordId"
                hiddenDelRec.value = reqRecId
                delForm.Insert("blocks", 0, hiddenDelRec)

                Dim hiddenDelOffset As Wydgit
                SET hiddenDelOffset = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"("task-card-delete-" & reqRecId & "-offset")
                hiddenDelOffset.name = "pageOffset"
                hiddenDelOffset.value = reqOffset
                delForm.Insert("blocks", 1, hiddenDelOffset)

                card.Insert("blocks", 1, delForm)

                Dim listSec As Wydgit
                SET listSec = FindNode(Me, "blocks", "taskboard-list-section")

                If listSec IS NOT NULL Then
                    Dim targetCol As Wydgit
                    SET targetCol = FindNode(listSec, "blocks", colId)

                    If targetCol IS NOT NULL Then
                        targetCol.Insert("blocks", 1, card)
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
    End If
END EVENT

FUNCTION FindNode(parent AS Wydgit, slotName AS String, sId AS String) AS Wydgit
    FOR EACH node IN parent.related("children", slotName)
        IF node.id = sId THEN
            RETURN node
        END IF
    NEXT node
    RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION

EVENT Submit
    Dim inputTitle As String
    inputTitle = REQUEST.Form.Get("title")

    Dim inputStatus As String
    inputStatus = REQUEST.Form.Get("status")

    If inputStatus = "" Then
        inputStatus = "todo"
    End If

    Dim rootSec As Wydgit
    SET rootSec = Me.related("parent")

    Dim statusBlock As Wydgit
    IF rootSec IS NOT NULL THEN
        SET statusBlock = FindNode(rootSec, "blocks", "taskboard-status-msg")
    END IF

    If inputTitle <> "" Then
        Dim recordId As String
        recordId = NewId()

        Dim res As Object
        res = SERVICES.Call("wydstore", "create", {
            "store": "tasks",
            "collection": "tasks",
            "id": recordId,
            "data": {
                "title": inputTitle,
                "status": inputStatus
            }
        })

        If res.ok Then
            IF statusBlock IS NOT NULL THEN
                statusBlock.content = {
                    "type": "markdown",
                    "value": "Task created successfully!"
                }
            END IF

            Dim titleField As Wydgit
            SET titleField = FindNode(Me, "blocks", "taskboard-title-field")

            IF titleField IS NOT NULL THEN
                titleField.value = ""
            End If
        Else
            IF statusBlock IS NOT NULL THEN
                statusBlock.content = {
                    "type": "markdown",
                    "value": "Failed to create task in store."
                }
            END IF
        End If
    End If
END EVENT

FUNCTION FindNode(parent AS Wydgit, slotName AS String, sId AS String) AS Wydgit
    FOR EACH node IN parent.related("children", slotName)
        IF node.id = sId THEN
            RETURN node
        END IF
    NEXT node
    RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION

EVENT Page.PreRender
    Dim currentOffset As Number
    currentOffset = 0

    Dim pageForm As Wydgit
    SET pageForm = FindNode(Me, "blocks", "taskboard-page-form")

    ' Read current offset state set by action handlers or form defaults
    If pageForm IS NOT NULL Then
        Dim offsetField AS Wydgit
        SET offsetField = FindNode(pageForm, "blocks", "taskboard-page-offset")
        If offsetField IS NOT NULL Then
            Dim rawOffsetVal AS String
            rawOffsetVal = offsetField.properties.value
            If rawOffsetVal IS NOT NULL THEN
                If rawOffsetVal <> "" Then
                    TRY
                        currentOffset = Val(rawOffsetVal)
                        If currentOffset < 0 Then
                            currentOffset = 0
                        End If
                    CATCH err
                        currentOffset = 0
                    FINALLY
                    END TRY
                End If
            End If
        End If
    End If

    Dim res As Object
    res = SERVICES.Call("wydstore", "query", {
        "store": "tasks",
        "collection": "tasks",
        "limit": 8,
        "offset": currentOffset
    })

    Dim rootSec As Wydgit
    SET rootSec = Me

    Dim statusBlock As Wydgit
    SET statusBlock = FindNode(rootSec, "blocks", "taskboard-status-msg")

    If res.ok Then
        Dim listSec As Wydgit
        SET listSec = FindNode(rootSec, "blocks", "taskboard-list-section")

        Dim colTodo As Wydgit
        Dim colDoing As Wydgit
        Dim colDone As Wydgit

        IF listSec IS NOT NULL THEN
            SET colTodo = FindNode(listSec, "blocks", "col-todo")
            SET colDoing = FindNode(listSec, "blocks", "col-doing")
            SET colDone = FindNode(listSec, "blocks", "col-done")
        END IF

        Dim records As Array
        records = res.value

        Dim taskData As Object
        Dim titleStr As String
        Dim statusStr As String
        Dim recId As String
        Dim cardId As String
        Dim card As Wydgit
        Dim targetCol As Wydgit

        Dim idxTodo As Number
        Dim idxDoing As Number
        Dim idxDone As Number
        idxTodo = 1
        idxDoing = 1
        idxDone = 1

        Dim targetIdx As Number
        Dim nextStatus As String
        Dim btnLabel As String

        Dim moveForm As Wydgit
        Dim recIdHiddenMove As Wydgit
        Dim nextStatusHidden As Wydgit
        Dim offsetHiddenMove As Wydgit
        Dim delForm As Wydgit
        Dim recIdHiddenDel As Wydgit
        Dim offsetHiddenDel As Wydgit
        Dim existingCard As Wydgit

        FOR EACH rec IN records
            recId = rec.id
            taskData = rec.data
            titleStr = taskData.title
            statusStr = taskData.status

            If statusStr = "doing" Then
                SET targetCol = colDoing
                targetIdx = idxDoing
                idxDoing = idxDoing + 1
                nextStatus = "done"
                btnLabel = "Complete ->"
            ElseIf statusStr = "done" Then
                SET targetCol = colDone
                targetIdx = idxDone
                idxDone = idxDone + 1
                nextStatus = "todo"
                btnLabel = "<- Reopen"
            Else
                SET targetCol = colTodo
                targetIdx = idxTodo
                idxTodo = idxTodo + 1
                nextStatus = "doing"
                btnLabel = "Start ->"
            End If

            cardId = "task-card-" & recId

            SET existingCard = NULL
            IF colTodo IS NOT NULL THEN
                IF existingCard IS NULL THEN
                    SET existingCard = FindNode(colTodo, "blocks", cardId)
                END IF
            END IF
            IF colDoing IS NOT NULL THEN
                IF existingCard IS NULL THEN
                    SET existingCard = FindNode(colDoing, "blocks", cardId)
                END IF
            END IF
            IF colDone IS NOT NULL THEN
                IF existingCard IS NULL THEN
                    SET existingCard = FindNode(colDone, "blocks", cardId)
                END IF
            END IF

            IF existingCard IS NULL THEN
                IF targetCol IS NOT NULL THEN
                    SET card = NEW "divdev/task-card"(cardId)
                    card.taskTitle = "**" & titleStr & "**"
                    card.status = statusStr
                    card.recordId = recId

                    ' 1. Move Form
                    SET moveForm = NEW "divdev/task-move-form"("task-card-move-" & recId)
                    moveForm.label = titleStr & " | " & btnLabel

                    SET recIdHiddenMove = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"("task-card-move-" & recId & "-recid")
                    recIdHiddenMove.name = "recordId"
                    recIdHiddenMove.value = recId
                    moveForm.Insert("blocks", 0, recIdHiddenMove)

                    SET nextStatusHidden = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"("task-card-move-" & recId & "-status")
                    nextStatusHidden.name = "targetStatus"
                    nextStatusHidden.value = nextStatus
                    moveForm.Insert("blocks", 1, nextStatusHidden)

                    SET offsetHiddenMove = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"("task-card-move-" & recId & "-offset")
                    offsetHiddenMove.name = "pageOffset"
                    offsetHiddenMove.value = CStr(currentOffset)
                    moveForm.Insert("blocks", 2, offsetHiddenMove)

                    card.Insert("blocks", 0, moveForm)

                    ' 2. Delete Form
                    SET delForm = NEW "divdev/task-delete-form"("task-card-delete-" & recId)
                    delForm.label = "Delete"

                    SET recIdHiddenDel = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"("task-card-delete-" & recId & "-recid")
                    recIdHiddenDel.name = "recordId"
                    recIdHiddenDel.value = recId
                    delForm.Insert("blocks", 0, recIdHiddenDel)

                    SET offsetHiddenDel = NEW "wydgit.core/hidden-input"("task-card-delete-" & recId & "-offset")
                    offsetHiddenDel.name = "pageOffset"
                    offsetHiddenDel.value = CStr(currentOffset)
                    delForm.Insert("blocks", 1, offsetHiddenDel)

                    card.Insert("blocks", 1, delForm)

                    targetCol.Insert("blocks", targetIdx, card)
                END IF
            END IF
        NEXT rec

        ' Calculate next/previous target offsets for subsequent render actions
        Dim prevForm As Wydgit
        SET prevForm = FindNode(rootSec, "blocks", "taskboard-prev-form")

        IF prevForm IS NOT NULL THEN
            Dim prevOffsetField AS Wydgit
            SET prevOffsetField = FindNode(prevForm, "blocks", "taskboard-prev-offset")
            IF prevOffsetField IS NOT NULL THEN
                Dim prevVal AS Number
                prevVal = currentOffset - 8
                If prevVal < 0 Then
                    prevVal = 0
                End If
                prevOffsetField.value = CStr(prevVal)
            END IF
        END IF

        IF pageForm IS NOT NULL THEN
            Dim nextOffsetField AS Wydgit
            SET nextOffsetField = FindNode(pageForm, "blocks", "taskboard-page-offset")
            IF nextOffsetField IS NOT NULL THEN
                nextOffsetField.value = CStr(currentOffset + 8)
            END IF
        END IF
    Else
        IF statusBlock IS NOT NULL THEN
            statusBlock.content = {
                "type": "markdown",
                "value": "Failed to load tasks from storage."
            }
        END IF
    End If
END EVENT
